::: proof

**Using @thm-deriv-matrix-vector:**

Since $\vx$ is constant with respect to $\vcoef$,
$\matr{A} = \tp{\vx}$ is a constant $1 \times p$ matrix.
Applying @thm-deriv-matrix-vector with $\vecf{v} = \vcoef$
(so $\deriv{\vcoef}\vcoef = \matr{I}$):

$$
\ba
\deriv{\vcoef}(\tp{\vx}\vcoef)
&= \paren{\deriv{\vcoef}\vcoef} \tp{(\tp{\vx})} \\
&= \matr{I} \cdot \vx \\
&= \vx
\ea
$$

:::
